meta.name: firecrawl-agent
meta.description: AI-powered autonomous data extraction that navigates complex sites and returns structured JSON. Use this skill when the user wants structured data from websites, needs to extract pricing tiers, product listings, directory entries, or any data as JSON with a schema. Triggers on "extract structured data", "get all the products", "pull pricing info", "extract as JSON", or when the user provides a JSON schema for website data. More powerful than simple scraping for multi-page structured extraction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从复杂网站提取结构化JSON数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从多页网站自动提取结构化数据为JSON格式
copy.tagline_en: Extract structured JSON data from complex websites
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically extract structured data from multi-page websites as JSON

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动浏览复杂网站，提取结构化数据（如价格、产品列表），并输出为 JSON 格式。
howto.when: 当你需要从多页网站提取结构化数据，或要求“提取所有产品”、“拉取定价信息”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我提取这个网站的所有产品信息，输出为 JSON。
say.note: Claude 会启动 agent 自动提取。

say.text: 从这些网址提取定价层级，用我给的 schema。
say.note: 需提供 JSON schema 约束输出格式。

say.text: 提取这个网站的功能列表，保存到文件。
say.note: Claude 会使用 --urls 和 -o 参数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can autonomously navigate complex websites, extract structured data (e.g., pricing, product listings), and output as JSON.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need structured data from multi-page sites, or when you say "extract all products", "pull pricing info", etc.

say_en.text: Extract all products from this site and output as JSON.
say_en.note: Claude will run the agent to extract.

say_en.text: Extract pricing tiers from these URLs using my schema.
say_en.note: Provide a JSON schema to structure output.

say_en.text: Get the feature list from this website and save to file.
